candidate_attempt_rule: There are five candidate slots. Each may use at most one new real tactical CLI and one fixed full-stage simulation. Contract or static failures retain the slot; only STARTED processes and simulations count against their applicable limits.
counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. Stop immediately on an 8-ID WIN. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, historical balance transfer, or sixth candidate. A pre-STARTED gate rejection without a model process does not count a CLI; a pre-reservation gate rejection without Simulator.run does not count a simulation.
non_stackable: M69 ended at candidate attempts 5/5, CLI 4/4, and simulation 5/5; its balances do not transfer. M52 V1 nine-operator WIN remains the frozen baseline until an M70 8-ID WIN is verified.
